integrity.computational_scope: 14 fully enumerated boards, 93 capacity cases, 1763138 nonempty tested subsets
integrity.proof_status: complete elementary proof of stated infinite theorem
integrity.unproved_extensions: No claims for triple Cartesian products or full classification of high-capacity minimum sets.

scientific_limitations: The formula applies to two-factor rook graphs, not arbitrary Cartesian products or higher-dimensional rook graphs.
The exact optimizer classification is only asserted for 1 <= k < min(m,n); the exact minimum itself holds for all 0 <= k <= m+n-2.

The full revised October 2026 text of arXiv:2606.22428 was inaccessible; the first-version complete text and the revised abstract were inspected. An unindexed earlier equivalent under (1,t)-domination is a residual risk.
title: Exact limited domination and low-capacity rigidity for rectangular rook graphs
